messages:
linda: FYI I'm pushing a config-only change in the late window (~00:30 UTC). Aim: reduce tail spikes by tightening per-tenant qps and making batching more eager for EU traffic. No model binaries changed.

deploy-bot: kicking off job #deploy-1721001112 -> services: routing, rate-limiter, batcher. Rollout plan: 5% -> 20% (3m) -> 70% (5m) -> 100% with automated health gates.

noah: please paste the exact config deltas so SRE can run local dry checks.

linda: posting snippet (applied via config service):

```yaml
routing:
  route_bias: eu-central-1
rate_limiter:
  tenant_max_qps: 35   # was 50
  token_bucket_size: 70
  refill_per_sec: 35
timeouts:
  conn_idle_ms: 1500    # was 900
batcher:
  micro_batch_size: 3   # was 6
  packing_window_ms: 12
kv_cache:
  prefetch_ratio: 0.25
```

tiffany: dropping micro_batch_size to 3 should reduce packing-induced tail, but could raise immediate request overhead. We'll watch token-per-second and p50 generation latency.

linda: health gates: sustained errors >0.5% over 2m OR p95_gen_latency +30% vs baseline OR refill drops >20% -> auto-rollback. Also alert if tenant_saturation > 0.7 for any top-10 tenant.

deploy-bot: gates configured for job #deploy-1721001112. Starting 5% canary now.

ops-sam: added short-lived dashboard row for this rollout (errors, p50/p95 gen latency, refill_rate, tenant_saturation). I'll monitor first 15m.

noah: running a smoke harness hitting long-context prompts and short-chat prompts. Will post results in ~4m.

noah: quick update: smoke passes, a couple of very-long-context samples show p99 increase but p95s ok. Nothing failing.

deploy-bot: canary at 5% healthy -> promoting to 20% (3m pause).

tiffany: seeing slight p50 bump (~8%) for EU small tenants, p95 stable. refill_rate steady. :eyes:

noah: eval summary: 38/40 checks pass. Two long-context latency spikes are expected due to smaller micro-batches; not quality regressions.

deploy-bot: 20% steady -> ramping to 70% after 5m hold.

linda: holding at 70% for 5m, ops-sam keep an eye on tenant_saturation and refill drops.

ops-sam: spotted one tenant with saturation 0.72 briefly, but it dropped back below threshold. I filed a quick note on the release row.

deploy-bot: promoting to 100% now. Job complete: all targets applied.

linda: thanks all. I created a revert config at https://git.internal/configs/reverts/1721001112 and a short rollback playbook pinned to the release row. Ping me before any revert.

tiffany: updated release notes: "Config-only: EU routing bias, tenant QPS lowered, micro-batching tightened, KV prefetch added. Goal: reduce tail amplification and smooth capacity." Internal doc: https://redwood.docs/releases/1721001112

noah: leaving a watch for 2h then handoff. ops-sam will escalate if anything noisy shows.

linda: closing thread, thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
